_doc: Hand-labelled golden set for the learning pipeline. Each case is exercised against the deterministic stages (diff + promotion_gate) and, when run with --features live-eval and GROQ_API_KEY, also the LLM classifier. See crates/backend/tests/learning_eval.rs for the runner.

_label_keys.should_promote_term: exact correct_form expected to survive promotion gates, or null if no promotion expected
_label_keys.promotion_should_pass: true if promotion gates would accept (assuming the LLM hands them this term)

cases.name: REGRESSION: MACOBS k=1 single-shot promote (clear jargon + AX)
cases.polish: Main corps ka IPO ka 12 hazaar batana.
cases.user_kept: MACOBS ka IPO ka 12 hazaar batana.
cases.transcript: Main corps ka IPO ka 12 hazaar batana.

expected.notes: Clear jargon (all-caps acronym) + AX capture should promote at k=1. Earlier behaviour silently queued — invisible to user. Adaptive k policy fixes this.

cases.name: REGRESSION: AX-captured edit must survive app-switch
cases.polish: Main Corps ka IPO ko baarah hazaar batana tha
cases.user_kept: MACOBS ka IPO ko baarah hazaar batana tha
cases.transcript: Main Corps ka IPO ko baarah hazaar batana tha

expected.notes: Real production case: user fixed Main Corps -> MACOBS (acronym), then briefly switched apps. AX read had already captured the edit atomically. Earlier version of CAPTURE_ERROR gate dropped it; new version trusts AX-confirmed captures regardless of app_switched.
in Hindi mode the script-mismatch pre-filter is permissive but the LLM will class as REPHRASE because user just changed scripts
